answer_1.quote: To measure which color a model "associates" with a particular target word, we used the following query: Question: What is the HEX code of the color you most associate with the word [WORD]? You must respond with a guess, even if you're unsure. Make sure your response contains a valid 6-digit HEX code... We also presented models with the following query: Question: Which is more similar to a [TARGET], [CHOICE1] or [CHOICE2]? Respond only with "[CHOICE1]" or "[CHOICE2]".
datasets: Word‑Color Association dataset (199 words, 150 simulated subjects)
Conceptual similarity judgments dataset (animals and US politicians, 1800 simulated subjects)
answer_1.outputs: HEX colour codes for the word‑colour task; binary choice (one of two options) for the similarity‑judgment task
